description:
Add the named extended BCH constructor used by OSD conformance and campaign work against the implementation-produced reference identity.

## Background

The existing named-constructor family stops at eBCH $(64,57)$. Published-source pinning supplies the primitive polynomial and construction provenance consumed by this factory.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `ExtendedBchCode::ebch_128_64()` constructs the pinned primitive BCH extension with $n=128$, $k=64$, and systematic generator form.
- [hard] REQ-02: A committed fixture records the pinned primitive polynomial plus canonical serialized generator and parity-check matrices.
- [hard] REQ-03: Tests verify fixture identity, matrix dimensions, orthogonality, systematic encoding, and even extension parity.
- [hard] REQ-04: Public rustdoc cites construction provenance and demonstrates the named factory workflow.
title: Named eBCH(128,64) reference factory
